model.return_basis: Yahoo adjusted close, cash dividends and splits adjusted
model.industry: ETF excess return residualized against intercept + six common factors on the same prior window
model.linking: daily contribution × prior cumulative stock wealth; sum equals compounded stock return

mapping.description: Manually maintained industry ETF proxies. Themes do not define industries; unmapped tickers have no attribution. ETFs are broad proxies and may hold the stock being analyzed.

model.classification: current manual proxy map, not historical membership

warnings: Attribution describes associations under the selected factors and industry proxies, not causation. Unexplained return is not proven alpha.
Industry ETFs are proxies and may hold the stock being analyzed. Manual classifications do not represent historical membership. Digital-asset themes are not assigned an industry proxy by default.
Public French factors have publication lags and historical revisions. Attribution ends at the latest date covered by both prices and complete factors; newer prices do not fill missing factor dates.
Attribution uses Yahoo dividend- and split-adjusted prices. Momentum above excludes dividends, so the return definitions may differ.
Estimation uses 252 complete trading sessions with coefficients lagged one session. Missing or collinear windows produce no result. R-squared is measured within the estimation window.
